content.title: Paired Water Floats | Alternating Load, Twin Wakes and Destination
content.summary: An adult estuary surveyor alternates two boot pontoons into a controlled beacon-bound glide. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity, one departure threshold, one distant destination and two separately bound flotation devices establish the baseline. + Every step assigns weight to one visible device before a corresponding ripple appears. + The two devices remain distinct and generate two traceable wake lines throughout the route. + A single look-back may interrupt gaze but cannot reverse travel direction or reset geography. + The final wide retains adult, departure landmark, destination axis and continuous wake proof.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original clearly adult estuary surveyor with a silver braid, teal dry suit and two separate amber ring-pontoons locked around her boots at a wooden research pier; keep one red beacon island centered in the distance. Alternate four readable steps away from the pier, preserving two distinct wake lines, stable suit identity and the same beacon direction. Accelerate into a controlled glide toward the beacon and end wide with the pier behind, the same adult centered and two uninterrupted wakes proving the completed route.

Every step assigns weight to one visible device before a corresponding ripple appears.
A single look-back may interrupt gaze but cannot reverse travel direction or reset geography.
The final wide retains adult, departure landmark, destination axis and continuous wake proof.

Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定同一成年人物、码头、水面和远方地标，先证明双脚分别绑定独立透明浮具；人物以左右脚交替承重离开码头，每次接触都产生可归因圆波和连续尾流，短暂回看后继续沿同一方向远离并接近既定目标。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity, one departure threshold, one distant destination and two separately bound flotation devices establish the baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity, one departure threshold, one distant destination and two separately bound flotation devices establish the baseline."

invariants.rule: Every step assigns weight to one visible device before a corresponding ripple appears.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every step assigns weight to one visible device before a corresponding ripple appears."

invariants.rule: The two devices remain distinct and generate two traceable wake lines throughout the route.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The two devices remain distinct and generate two traceable wake lines throughout the route."

invariants.rule: A single look-back may interrupt gaze but cannot reverse travel direction or reset geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A single look-back may interrupt gaze but cannot reverse travel direction or reset geography."

invariants.rule: The final wide retains adult, departure landmark, destination axis and continuous wake proof.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final wide retains adult, departure landmark, destination axis and continuous wake proof."
